messages:
maria: pushed a tiny rename + autoformat in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4302 — CI is now failing across multiple packages. who can help merge a revert or give a fast approval? :pray:

ci-bot: build failed on commit `a1b2c3d` — go test failed in `pkg/serve` and `pkg/kvcache` (see checks)

kevin: link? which commit SHA?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4302/commits/a1b2c3d — I accidentally ran a global formatter after the rename, created noisy diffs.

sam: ok. easiest unblock is `git revert --no-edit a1b2c3d` -> push a small revert PR. I can open it if you want.

jess: I can approve a revert if tests pass. can we run the unit tests locally quickly? (CI flakes sometimes)

maria: running locally now — `go test ./...` shows only the 2 packages failing because of an import reorder; revert should restore green.

akash: if you open the revert PR, tag me and I'll queue merge during the minor-release window. also consider adding a short note to PR description so codeowners don't get pinged multiple times.

kevin: fwiw, for future, prefer `git add -p` or set formatter only for package dir. global formatters are risky. maybe add a pre-commit hook.

maria: agreed. I'll open revert PR and include `Fixes: revert accidental formatter` in description. thanks all.

sam: created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4305 — cc @jess @akash

ci-bot: PR checks queued — running `go vet`, unit tests, linters.

jess: LGTM, merging once CI is green :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Checks passed. merged by jess at 2024-06-14T15:45:05Z

maria: thanks! will follow up with pre-commit hook RFC in #eng.

kevin: :clap:
